note: Hancock County, IA publishes its zoning only as static PDF maps, one per township (hancockcountyia.gov/zoning/zoning_maps), with no ArcGIS REST or other queryable zoning polygon service found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Hancock County and Britt/Garner zoning found no zoning layer. Garner's city site links only a downloadable zoning map file, also not a service. Britt and Klemme were not found publishing GIS zoning either.
